Why Hire iOS Programmers With Mobilunity

Experienced iOS Developers 

With access to a global iOS talent pool, we find niche-skilled and industry-specific mobile app developers. After thorough research of your requirements, we can find a perfect match expert and close a vacancy with an average of 2.5 interviews.

Up to 2X Reduction of  Costs

Since we can hire iPhone app developers in different nearshore and offshore countries worldwide, our clients can cut their project costs almost twice. With Mobilunity, you can access experts with competitive salaries yet strong STEM skills.

Full Control over Your Developers

When you engage remote iOS developers from Mobilunity, you completely control their workload and performance. Your Project Manager assigns tasks, coordinates your team, and ensures that development deliverables are high-quality.

Up to 50% Faster Recruiting than In-House

Due to thorough research of your requirements, access to the global tech talent pool, and proven hiring approaches, Mobilunity’s recruiters can find iOS developers in 3-6 weeks. This process is up to 2X faster than typical employment.

Focus on Retention

Effective and ongoing retention is one of the backbones of Mobilunity’s 3R philosophy of success. We regularly monitor your iOS mobile developers’ motivation and engagement to ensure long-term collaboration and fulfillment of expectations.

Hassle-Free Back-Office Support

Mobilunity’s HR team helps you stay focused on your iOS application development by taking daunting admin tasks off your shoulders. You manage your tech team, and we handle legal, accounting, provide an IT helpdesk, and other services.

iOS App Development Services and Customization

Development of iOS Design

From research and planning to microinteractions and launch — your app development team will help you create aesthetic, intuitive, and functional designs for any iOS software.

Custom iOS Development

Hired developers will assist you in crafting unique applications that meet specific business needs. They’ll consider the app’s structure and backend services as well as design, security, and scalability.

Building M-Commerce Applications

With Mobilunity’s tech professionals, you’ll build intuitive, user-centric, mobile-first apps for commercial activities with secure payments, AI-powered personalization, and targeted push notifications.

iPhone Game Development

Hire engineers from Mobilunity to create engaging and interactive games for Apple smartphones. From the idea, gameplay mechanics, and monetization strategy to selecting the game engines and audio design and integration with iOS features — they’ll cover it all based on your needs.

Device-Specific Development

Apple Watch App Development

Use our watchOS adepts’ expertise to help you leverage wearable technologies. By prioritizing essential features and minimal interaction, they’ll create solutions with the required functionality, optimized performance, and minimalistic UI.

Apple TV App Development

Engage Mobilunity’s tvOS specialists to build applications for large screens with specific interaction methods. Let your iOS development team contribute to creating immersive experiences like video streaming, home automation, gaming, or fitness.

App Development Approaches

Native iOS App Development

Build a team of professional developers who’ll help you develop solutions with the platform’s native languages and tools. Responsive and performance-optimized apps will allow you to increase reach, grow the audience and boost revenues.

Hybrid App Development

Take advantage of having a single codebase for multiple platforms and devices, effectively wrapping your hybrid application in a native shell — all with the assistance of the qualified developers you contract through Mobilunity.

Xamarin Development

Once you need a cross-platform mobile app with a shared codebase for Windows, iOS and Android, contract developers with Mobilunity to implement even custom UIs with a native look and feel.

Other Services

App Testing and QA

Engage our top-tier QA engineers to run functional, usability, performance, compatibility, security, localization, and beta tests to make sure your application meets your requirements.

App Migration to iOS

Our seasoned mobile developers will help you move appі from another platform, irrespective of its complexity and architecture. They’ll ensure feature parity and adaptation to iOS design and features.

Maintenance and Support

Mobilunity’s tech specialists will help support your iOS solution after its release. They’ll take care of its regular updates, bug fixes, performance optimization, and compatibility with new iOS versions.

Consulting on iOS Mobile App Development

Following best practices, our iOS experts will advise you on the app’s concept, UX/UI design, programming and architecture, testing and debugging, data protection, and maintenance.

Our iOS Developers For Hire Can Also Assist With

Xcode Integrated Development Environment

The application developers you contract use Xcode’s suite of tools to design, code, test, and debug solutions for macOS, iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and watchOS based on your needs.

Technical Stack Selection

Your iOS developers will select the most appropriate programming language according to your project requirements, performance needs, development speed, etc. 

UI and UX Design Implementation

Mobilunity’s engineers will help you create appealing UIs with Xcode’s Interface Builder, XIB files, and storyboards. They’ll also use SwiftUI and HIG (Human Interface Guidelines) to build consistent interfaces that are aligned with your requirements.

Git Version Control

With our professional software developers, you’ll be able to track every change in your project’s codebase, revert to earlier versions, and foster effective dev team collaboration, process automation, and troubleshooting.

Dependency Management

Mobilunity’s app engineers will centrally manage dependencies using CocoaPods or Carthage to easily update external iOS frameworks and libraries. With these tools, your team integrates and updates external code with minimal effort.

Continuous Integration and Deployment

With CI/CD practices, our developers will help your application get to market faster, while automated testing ensures code quality and consistency. These principles also improve team collaboration and better visibility of your app development process. 

Collecting User Feedback

Our iOS developers use platforms like PickFu to get input from the audience. This valuable real-life feedback allows coders to improve your app’s usability, identify bugs, control features, and align your product’s design with customer needs.

Analytics and Monitoring

Your developers track user behavior and monitor performance to identify trends, engagement patterns, user segmentation. They help you get insights into app usage and crashes from Firebase and Mixpanel and deliver ongoing improvements.

FAQs

How much does it cost to hire an iOS developer with Mobilunity?

The cost will depend on the country where your specialists live, their skill sets, and our cooperation format. Schedule a free consultation to calculate an estimated cost for your project.

Which are the top programming languages for iOS development?

The most popular languages among iOS developers are Swift (modern native app development), Objective-C (for legacy code), C# (for Xamarin framework), JavaScript (for React Native), and Dart (for Flutter).

Can I hire full-time app developers?

Absolutely, you can extend your in-house team with full-time developers or assemble a dedicated team. You get full functional control over your tech professionals, while back-office tasks remain at our end.

Do you offer assistance with technical interviews?

Sure, we offer technical interviews as a service for customers who don’t have resources or can’t engage in-house experts in multiple tech assessments. Our consultants give professional recommendations on each candidate so you can hire top iOS developers for your project.

What business benefits does mobile app development offer?

Successful iOS applications boast exceptional user experience, a loyal user base, and higher revenue potential. They also have robust security, faster development, optimized software and hardware integration, and high Apple App Store visibility.

How does custom app development help my business?

Our iPhone app developers for hire help you build customized solutions that can improve customer engagement, grow brand awareness, accelerate workflows, and help you discover new revenue streams. Due to exclusive features, iPad and iPhone apps are scalable and more competitive, allowing you to get customer insights.

Can I outsource an entire iOS development project to Mobilunity?

We don’t deliver turnkey app development projects. Instead, we help you find and onboard a team of iOS app developers who’ll help you complete a project and ensure your app is well-maintained and updated promptly.

How fast can I hire an iPhone developer?

Our recruiters can contract an expert iOS developer within 3-6 weeks so you can start building high-quality iOS mobile applications.

What other iOS development services do your software developers provide?

They offer iOS hosting, development of applications for startups and enterprises, ERP/CRM/CMS integration, and containerizing iOS applications with Docker, using advanced techniques and practices. 

Is it possible to collaborate with iOS developers for short-term projects?

Indeed, we provide adaptable engagement models, enabling you to employ iOS developers for temporary requirements or particular project stages, like prototyping or MVP creation.

Is it possible to rapidly expand my development team?

Certainly. With Mobilunity, you can effortlessly adjust the size of your iOS development team according to your iOS project needs and schedules.

Are your developers adhering to Agile methodologies?

Indeed, our iOS developers are skilled in Agile and various contemporary project management methods to guarantee effective development and prompt delivery.

What assistance do you offer following the hiring of developers?

We provide ongoing support that encompasses team management help, monitoring progress, and addressing any operational issues that may occur.

Can I get developers for iPad development?

Absolutely! We can help you hire software engineers tailored to your specific project needs. iOS developers specialize in creating and adapting applications seamlessly for both iPhones and iPads.
